advanced.desc: When you are targeted by an attack, impose Disadvantage on the attack roll. If the attack misses (or Glancing Blow becomes miss for this purpose), move 10 ft. without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Once per round.

advanced.name: Infernal Engine
advanced.desc: Wrath Form: at the start of each of your turns, if you dealt damage to at least one enemy on your previous turn, recover 2 PP.

expert.name: Devour Essence
expert.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: target makes a Fort Save or is Stunned until the end of their next turn. Boss-tier creatures have Advantage on this save.

expert.name: Soul Harvest
expert.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: recover HP equal to the damage dealt, and gain temporary HP equal to half that amount.

expert.name: Executioner's Mark
expert.desc: Add to a melee attack against a target below 50% HP. Full Hit: deal +3d6 bonus damage. If this kills the target, recover 4 PP.

expert.name: Daemonic Trample
expert.desc: Move up to 20 ft. in a straight line. Every enemy in your path makes a REF Save or takes 2d8 damage and is knocked Prone.

expert.name: Daemonfire Detonation
expert.desc: Choose one enemy within 30 ft. All creatures within 10 ft. of them — allies included — take 3d8 damage (REF Save for half).

expert.name: Abyssal Counter
expert.desc: When hit by a melee attack: attack back immediately. On a Full Hit, the attacker is also Staggered until the end of their next turn.

expert.name: Unending Hatred
expert.desc: Whenever an enemy within 30 ft. is reduced to 0 HP by any source, immediately recover 4 PP. If you have not yet acted this round, your next attack has Advantage.

expert.name: Momentum of the Hunt
expert.desc: Wrath Form: each consecutive turn you deal damage to at least one enemy grants a cumulative +1 to all damage rolls (max +5). Resets if you take no offensive action on a turn or switch to Spite Form.

expert.name: Abyssal Frenzy
expert.desc: Make three melee attacks against any targets within reach. For each Full Hit, recover 1 PP.

basic.name: Rime Blight
basic.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: target's speed −10 ft. and they take 1d4 Cold damage at the start of each of their turns for 3 rounds. Reapplying before it ends: extend to 3 rounds and add +1d4 damage (max 3 stacks).

basic.name: Sanguine Rot
basic.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: target takes 1d6 Necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns for 3 rounds. Each time this deals damage, you recover 1 HP.

basic.name: Necrotic Wound
basic.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: any healing the target receives is halved until the end of their next turn.

basic.name: Hungering Cold
basic.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: deal +1d6 Cold damage. If the target currently has Rime Blight: deal +2d6 Cold instead.

basic.name: Death's Tithe
basic.desc: Add to any melee attack at no cost. Deal +1d6 bonus damage per 5 Grave Toll you currently have (max +2d6). Does not consume Grave Toll.

basic.name: Marked for the Grave
basic.desc: Mark one enemy within 30 ft. The next attack against them (by you or an ally) deals +1d6 bonus damage. Consumed when triggered.

basic.name: Chains of Ice
basic.desc: One enemy within 20 ft. makes a Fort Save or is Restrained until the end of their next turn.

basic.name: Icy Touch
basic.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 2d6 Cold damage and the target cannot use their Reaction until the start of your next turn.

basic.name: Grave's Endurance
basic.desc: When you take damage: reduce that damage by an amount equal to your current Grave Toll, then set Grave Toll to 0.

basic.name: Bonebreaker
basic.desc: Your melee attacks deal +1d6 bonus damage against targets that are Slowed, Staggered, or Restrained.

basic.name: Runic Empowerment
basic.desc: Whenever you spend Grave Toll on any ability, your next melee attack this turn deals +1d4 bonus damage.

advanced.name: Virulent Plague
advanced.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: apply both Rime Blight and Sanguine Rot simultaneously. If the target already has either, existing stacks increase by 1.

advanced.name: Empowered Death's Tithe
advanced.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: deal double weapon damage and recover HP equal to the damage dealt.

advanced.name: Rending Chill
advanced.desc: Add to a melee attack against a target that has Rime Blight. Full Hit: reduce the target's DEF by 2 until the end of their next turn.

advanced.name: Ghost Stride
advanced.desc: Until the start of your next turn: +10 ft. speed, ignore difficult terrain, and you cannot be forcibly moved or Grappled.

advanced.name: Pestilence
advanced.desc: Choose one enemy afflicted with Rime Blight or Sanguine Rot within 30 ft. Spread both afflictions at their current stack count to all enemies within 10 ft. of them.

advanced.name: Deathchill
advanced.desc: All enemies within 10 ft. of you that currently have Rime Blight take 1d8 additional Cold damage immediately, and their Rime Blight stack count is set to its maximum.

advanced.name: Relentless Decay
advanced.desc: Your DoT effects deal +1 damage per tick for every 3 Grave Toll you currently have.

expert.name: Asphyxiate
expert.desc: Add to a melee attack. Full Hit: target makes a Fort Save or is Stunned until the end of their next turn. Boss-tier creatures have Advantage.

expert.name: Soul Reaper
expert.desc: Add to a melee attack against a target below 35% HP. Full Hit: mark the target. At the start of your next turn, if the mark is still active, they take 4d6 Necrotic damage and you recover that much HP.

expert.name: Obliterate
expert.desc: Add to a melee attack. Deal +2d8 bonus damage. For each DoT effect currently active on the target, deal an additional +1d6 damage. This does not remove the DoT effects.

expert.name: Grave Leeches
expert.desc: Release Grave Leeches. At the start of each of your next 3 turns, recover 1d6 HP.

expert.name: Remorseless Winter
expert.desc: All enemies within 15 ft. must make a Fort Save or be Slowed and take 2d6 Cold damage.

expert.name: Death's Counter
expert.desc: When hit by a melee attack: attack back immediately. On a Full Hit, the attacker is also Staggered until the end of their next turn.

expert.name: Winter's Grasp
expert.desc: When an enemy moves away from you: they must make a Fort Save or their speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their turn.

expert.name: Harvester's Presence
expert.desc: Enemies within 10 ft. of you cannot regain HP by any means.

expert.name: Inevitable
expert.desc: While you have 5 or more Grave Toll, you cannot be moved against your will by any forced movement effect.

expert.name: Army of the Damned
expert.desc: Once per Long Rest. Summon 3 Ghouls (6–8 HP, deal 1d6+2 damage). You may command them as a Free Action each turn.

basic.name: Grasping Dead
basic.desc: Add to Command Legion. Full Hit: target is Grappled until the start of their next turn (Fort Save negates).

basic.name: Festering Wound
basic.desc: Add to Command Legion. Full Hit: target takes 1d6 Necrotic damage now and at the start of each of their turns for 3 rounds. Damage increases by +1 each tick (cumulative).

basic.name: Bone Shrapnel
basic.desc: Add to Command Legion. On any hit: all enemies within 5 ft. of the target take 1d4 Piercing damage.

basic.name: Draining Strike
basic.desc: Add to Command Legion. Full Hit: recover HP equal to half the damage dealt.

basic.name: Bone Armor
basic.desc: Gain temporary HP equal to 1d6 + PRES modifier.

basic.name: Rattling Charge
basic.desc: One Skeleton in your Legion may move up to 30 ft. before you use Command Legion this turn, without using your Command Legion action.

basic.name: Ghoul's Grasp
basic.desc: One Skeleton in your Legion attempts to Grapple an adjacent enemy using your PRES modifier for the contested check.

basic.name: Creeping Decay
basic.desc: Target within 30 ft. takes 1d4 Necrotic damage now and at the start of each of their turns. Each turn the die increases one step: 1d4→1d6→1d8→1d10 (max). Lasts 5 rounds or until cleansed.

basic.name: Echoing Wail
basic.desc: All enemies within 15 ft. of you must make a Will Save or be Frightened until the end of their next turn.

basic.name: Bone Ward
basic.desc: When you or an ally within 10 ft. would take damage: destroy 1 Skeleton, reduce that damage by 1d8.

basic.name: Last Rites
basic.desc: When an ally within 10 ft. takes damage: destroy 1 Skeleton, that ally immediately recovers 1d8 HP.

basic.name: Marrow Feast
basic.desc: Whenever any Skeleton in your Legion is destroyed (by any means), you recover 1 PP.

basic.name: Necrotic Presence
basic.desc: Enemies within 10 ft. of any of your active Skeletons have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Bonds.

advanced.name: Plague Spread
advanced.desc: Add to Command Legion. On any hit against a target with Festering Wound or Creeping Decay: spread that DoT to all enemies within 10 ft. of the target at its current damage value.

advanced.name: Soul Harvest
advanced.desc: Add to Command Legion. If Command Legion kills any creature this turn: recover 3 PP and immediately raise that creature as a Skeleton (Free Action, no PP).

advanced.name: Withering Touch
advanced.desc: Add to Command Legion. Full Hit: any healing the target receives is halved until the end of their next turn.

advanced.name: Unfailing Command
advanced.desc: Command Legion this turn is an automatic Full Hit — no attack roll required.

advanced.name: Necrotic Aura
advanced.desc: Until the start of your next turn: any enemy that enters or starts within 15 ft. of you takes 1d6 Necrotic damage (once per creature per round).

advanced.name: Death Coil
advanced.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 2d8 Necrotic damage (half on Glancing Blow). Alternatively, target an ally: they recover 2d8 HP instead.

advanced.name: Ossuary Span
advanced.desc: Consume up to 3 Skeletons. Per Skeleton consumed: create a 5 ft. section of solid bone terrain (wall, bridge, or platform) in an unoccupied space within 30 ft. Each section has 15 HP and persists until destroyed.

advanced.name: Bone Colossus
advanced.desc: Consume your entire Legion (set Count to 0). Raise a single Bone Colossus: HP = 10 × Skeletons consumed, deals 2d8 per attack. Command using a Bonus Action each turn. Lasts until destroyed or end of combat.

advanced.name: Plague of the Grave
advanced.desc: All enemies within 15 ft. of any active Skeleton must make a Fort Save or be Poisoned for 3 rounds.

expert.name: Paralytic Rot
expert.desc: Add to Command Legion. Full Hit: target makes a Fort Save or is Paralyzed until the end of their next turn. Boss-tier creatures have Advantage.

expert.name: Legion's Wrath
expert.desc: Command Legion this turn deals 2d4 damage per Skeleton instead of 1d4.

expert.name: Soul Rend
expert.desc: Add to Command Legion. Full Hit: reduce the target's maximum HP by 1d8 until their next Long Rest, and you recover that much HP.

expert.name: Epidemic
expert.desc: Choose one enemy within 30 ft. afflicted by any of your DoT effects. That DoT immediately spreads to all enemies within 15 ft. of them at its current damage value.

expert.name: Plague Lord's Decree
expert.desc: All enemies within 20 ft. must make a Fort Save or be Poisoned and have their DEF reduced by 2 until the end of combat.

expert.name: Death's Embrace
expert.desc: When an enemy within 30 ft. is reduced to 0 HP: all enemies within 10 ft. of that creature must make a Fort Save or be Frightened until the end of their next turn.

expert.name: Grave Shield
expert.desc: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP: consume 3 Skeletons to reduce to 0 HP instead. Once per Long Rest. (You survive at 0 HP, stabilized; same as being reduced normally without death saves if your system uses them.)

expert.name: Harvest of Souls
expert.desc: Consume your entire Legion. Per Skeleton consumed: recover 2 PP and 1d4 HP.

expert.name: Soul Barrage
expert.desc: Deal 2d6 Necrotic damage to all enemies within 20 ft. Recover 2 HP per enemy affected. If 3 or more enemies are affected, also recover 2 PP.

basic.name: Wild Bargain
basic.desc: Roll 1d4: (1) Frightened, (2) Slowed, (3) you gain +10 ft. speed, (4) roll again and apply to original target + one additional target within 30 ft. Stacks on repeated 4s.

basic.name: Thorned Glamour
basic.desc: Enemy 30 ft. will Save or attacks the nearest creature (ally or enemy) on their next turn instead of acting normally.

basic.name: Stolen Step
basic.desc: Swap positions instantly with any creature within 30 ft. (willing or not). Will Save negates for unwilling targets.

basic.name: Faerie Fire
basic.desc: Target within 30 ft. is outlined in glowing light until end of your next turn. Attacks against them have Advantage; they cannot benefit from Invisible or Hidden condition.

basic.name: Fool's Luck
basic.desc: Impose Disadvantage on one enemy's next Saving Throw. Flip a coin: on a loss, the Disadvantage applies to your own next roll instead.

basic.name: Glamoured Disguise
basic.desc: For 1 minute, you appear as a different humanoid of your approximate size. Purely cosmetic.

basic.name: Capricious Step
basic.desc: When you would be hit by an attack, teleport up to 10 ft. to an unoccupied space. If no longer in the attack's reach or area, it deals no damage.

basic.name: Mischief's Blade
basic.desc: Your next attack this turn deals +2d4 Psychic damage. Full Hit: the target's next attack has Disadvantage.

advanced.name: Revel's Edge
advanced.desc: Whenever any Critical Hit occurs within 30 ft. (yours, an ally's, or an enemy's), you may spend this Bond as a Free Action to immediately recover 4 PP.

advanced.name: Wicked Trade
advanced.desc: Swap your current HP total with one enemy within 30 ft. (Will Save negates).

advanced.name: Tithe to the Hollow Hill
advanced.desc: One ally within 30 ft. gains 10 temporary HP. If any remains at the start of their next turn, they are Slowed until the end of their following turn.

advanced.name: Changeling's Mercy
advanced.desc: Remove all Basic and Advanced conditions from one ally within 30 ft. Roll 1d4: on a 1, you gain one random Basic condition instead.

expert.name: The Hunt Answers
expert.desc: Until the end of combat (activated once). Once per round, when an enemy within 30 ft. takes a Critical Hit from any source, they are also Frightened until the end of their next turn.

expert.name: Unmaking Jest
expert.desc: Target within 30 ft. must make a Will Save or be Stunned until the end of their next turn (laughing uncontrollably at a joke only they can hear). Boss-tier creatures have Advantage.

expert.name: Court's Judgment
expert.desc: Target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save. Failure: roll 1d4: (1) Paralyzed until end of next turn, (2) teleported 30 ft. in a random direction, (3) swaps all conditions with you, (4) their next turn is skipped entirely. Boss-tier have Advantage.

expert.name: Cruel Laughter
expert.desc: All enemies within 20 ft. make a Will Save or take 3d6 Psychic damage and are Distracted until end of their next turn. Success: half damage, no condition.

basic.name: Hollow Touch
basic.desc: Make a melee attack that deals +2d6 bonus damage. Full Hit: drain 1d4 RP from the target (they lose it; you do not gain it).

basic.name: Devouring Dark
basic.desc: Target within 30 ft. takes 2d6 damage. You recover HP equal to half the damage dealt.

basic.name: Whispers from Beyond
basic.desc: Choose a point within 60 ft. All enemies within 15 ft. of that point must make a Will Save or be Frightened until the end of their next turn.

basic.name: Creeping Void
basic.desc: Target within 30 ft. and all enemies within 5 ft. of them take 1d6 damage and have their Speed reduced by 5 ft. until the end of their next turn.

basic.name: Entropic Strike
basic.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 2d6 + PRES modifier Necrotic damage. Full Hit: reduce the target's maximum HP by 1d4 until their next Long Rest.

basic.name: Siphon the Seam
basic.desc: One enemy within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or loses 1d4 RP (you gain that amount as PP instead).

basic.name: Null Touch
basic.desc: When an enemy within 30 ft. would regain HP or RP from any source: halve the amount regained (Will Save negates).

advanced.name: Unraveling
advanced.desc: Target within 30 ft. loses 1 DEF at the start of each of their turns (stacks up to 3) until the end of combat.

advanced.name: Maddening Whisper
advanced.desc: Target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or is Distracted and Frightened until the end of their next turn.

advanced.name: Hungering Void
advanced.desc: Your next attack this turn that deals damage also drains 1d4 RP from the target on any hit.

advanced.name: Devourer's Patience
advanced.desc: When an enemy within 30 ft. drops below 25% HP: they take 1d8 Necrotic damage and you recover HP equal to half that amount.

expert.name: Devour Essence
expert.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 3d6 damage (half on Glancing Blow). Full Hit: target is Weakened until end of their next turn; you recover HP equal to half the damage dealt.

expert.name: Collapse the Self
expert.desc: Target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or is Paralyzed until the end of their next turn as the Void unmakes their sense of self. Boss-tier have Advantage.

expert.name: Starving Rift
expert.desc: For 1 round, your Void Bonds deal an additional 1d6 damage and drain 1 additional RP from the target on a Full Hit.

expert.name: Annihilate
expert.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 4d6 Necrotic damage (half on Glancing Blow). Full Hit: you may immediately use Pact Tax as a Free Action.

expert.name: Consuming Darkness
expert.desc: 15 ft. cone. All creatures in the area take 4d6 Necrotic damage (REF Save for half). You recover HP equal to half the total damage dealt.

basic.name: Verdict
basic.desc: Declare a compulsion on one enemy within 30 ft. (e.g., 'you will not attack my ally'). If they break it before your next turn, they immediately take 2d8 Radiant damage.

basic.name: Compelling Gaze
basic.desc: One enemy within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or redirects their next attack this round to a target of your choice (ally or enemy).

basic.name: Judging Light
basic.desc: Illuminate a 20 ft. radius with harsh celestial light for 1 round. Enemies within cannot benefit from the Hidden or Invisible condition.

basic.name: Censure
basic.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 2d6 Radiant damage (half on Glancing Blow). Full Hit: the target cannot benefit from Resistance or Immunity to Radiant damage until the end of your next turn.

basic.name: Divine Condemnation
basic.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 2d6 + PRES modifier Radiant damage. Full Hit: the target has Disadvantage on their next Saving Throw.

basic.name: Weight of Conscience
basic.desc: One enemy within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or has Disadvantage on their next Attack Roll.

basic.name: Searing Verdict
basic.desc: One enemy within 30 ft. that is currently affected by any of your Celestial Bonds takes 1d6 Radiant damage immediately.

advanced.name: Binding Oath
advanced.desc: Target within 30 ft. makes a Fort Save or is Grappled by radiant chains until the end of their next turn.

advanced.name: Reckoning
advanced.desc: Mark one enemy. The next time they take any action that harms one of your allies, they immediately take 3d4 Radiant damage as delayed judgment. Lasts until triggered or end of combat.

advanced.name: Trial by Fire
advanced.desc: Target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or is Restrained until the end of their next turn and takes 1d8 Radiant damage immediately.

advanced.name: Wings of Judgment
advanced.desc: Gain a fly speed of 20 ft. until the end of your next turn. The first attack you make against an enemy below you this turn has Advantage.

expert.name: Final Sentence
expert.desc: 30 ft. ranged attack: deal 3d8 Radiant damage (half on Glancing Blow). Full Hit: target makes a Will Save or is Stunned until end of next turn. Boss-tier have Advantage.

expert.name: Absolute Decree
expert.desc: Up to 2 enemies within 30 ft. each make a Will Save or are Restrained by radiant chains until the end of their next turn (resolve each independently).

expert.name: Echo of Judgment
expert.desc: Active until end of combat (activated once). Whenever Verdict, Reckoning, or Final Sentence triggers its bonus damage, all allies within 15 ft. of the target gain +1d4 to their next attack roll against that target.

expert.name: The Court Convenes
expert.desc: Up to 3 enemies within 30 ft. each make a Will Save or are Restrained by radiant chains until the end of their next turn (resolve each independently).

expert.name: Pillar of Judgment
expert.desc: Choose a point within 60 ft. A 10 ft. radius column of radiant light strikes. Enemies in the area take 4d8 Radiant damage (REF Save for half). Allies in the area recover 1d8 HP.
